title: Getting Started with ASP.NET Core MVC
description: Set up your development environment, build your first MVC app, complete a CRUD application, and understand the MVC architecture — everything you need to start your ASP.NET Core journey.
longDescription: This module is your complete on-ramp to ASP.NET Core MVC. You will install the .NET 8.0 SDK, configure Visual Studio 2022 or VS Code, and build a working MVC application from scratch. Along the way you will learn how Controllers, Views, and Models collaborate through the MVC pattern, how to pass data using ViewBag and strongly-typed Models, and how to build a full Create-Read-Update-Delete application with model validation and tag helpers. The module closes with a guided roadmap to the rest of the ASP.NET Core ecosystem.
whatYouLearn: Install and configure the .NET 8.0 SDK with Visual Studio 2022 or VS Code
Create and run an ASP.NET Core MVC project using Visual Studio and the dotnet CLI
Understand the MVC folder structure: Controllers, Models, Views, and wwwroot
Write controller action methods that return plain strings, View results, and strongly-typed Models
Pass dynamic data to Views using ViewBag and strongly-typed Model declarations
Build a complete CRUD application with Create, Read, Update, and Delete operations
Use tag helpers (asp-for, asp-action, asp-validation-for) to reduce boilerplate HTML
Apply model validation using Data Annotation attributes
Understand how model binding and ModelState.IsValid protect your application from bad data
Compare ASP.NET Core with older frameworks and understand the MVC request lifecycle
Navigate the ASP.NET Core learning roadmap and know what to study next
